event: Dispatch team begins loading; floor-level pallet staged at east bay.
Operator approaches the pallet and raises the forks to lift the load.
Pallet shifts about 20 cm on the forks; operator stops. No contact or injury.
source: Operator and picker interviews; bay camera 08:42

event: Truck parked, load lowered, and bay temporarily isolated.
Competent check finds two damaged lower boards and mixed pallet footprints; dispatch resumes with inspected pallets only.
